dedupe_keys.name: argentina secretariat of transport open data portal

description: The open data portal of Argentina's transport administration (datos.transporte.gob.ar) holds 48 datasets from the Secretariat of Transport's observatory and planning directorates, the national ports administration (AGP) and the civil aviation agency. Road data include national and provincial routes, tertiary roads, pavements, kilometre posts, tolls, average annual daily traffic (TMDA) and a road freight origin-destination matrix; rail data include the integrated rail system (SIFER), stations and active services, level crossings, tickets sold and a rail freight cost model (COSFER); aviation data include airports, aerodromes, airport land parcels and landings and take-offs; port data include ports, port terminals and ship arrivals and departures; and public transport data cover SUBE card usage, bus routes, lines and operators in the Buenos Aires metropolitan area. Coverage is national, with metropolitan detail for Buenos Aires. The portal runs on CKAN with an API; datasets are free, 21 under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, 16 under other open licences and 11 without a stated licence, as CSV, XLSX, KML, GeoJSON and shapefiles. Caveats: update frequency varies and some datasets lack a licence. The networks and traffic counts support network flow and capacity planning models and hazard exposure of Argentine transport. It complements the SUBE transactions record.
